faqEntries.heading: Can I customize the Dinosaur Dimension?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Open the Dinosaur Dimension Wiki and select Dinosaur Dimension Settings. From there, you can customize dinosaur spawning and difficulty, visual effects, sounds, and achievement notifications.

faqEntries.heading: How can I learn more about a dinosaur before approaching it?
faqEntries.content: Hold the Dinosaur Binoculars in your hand, hold interact to activate them, then aim directly at a dinosaur to display its stats.

faqEntries.heading: How do I find all Dinosaur Dimension recipes?
faqEntries.content:
Open a Crafting Table, open the recipe book, use the search bar if needed, and set the filter to All to view every available recipe. All Dinosaur Dimension recipes are unlocked by default.

To learn more about the Dinosaur Dimension, craft the Dinosaur Dimension Wiki using 1 Book and 1 Bone.

faqEntries.heading: How do I summon Dinosaur Bosses?
faqEntries.content:
Build a T shape using 4 Dinosaur Bone Blocks, then place a dinosaur head on top of it.

Tyrannosaurus Rex Head → Apex Predator Boss
Zombiesaurus Minion Head → Zombiesaurus Boss
Skelosaurus Minion Skull → Skelosaurus Boss

Placing the dinosaur head starts the boss-summoning event.

faqEntries.heading: Can I bring blocks and items back to the Overworld?
faqEntries.content: Yes! You can bring Dinosaur Dimension blocks, prehistoric plants, materials, fossils, and other resources back to the Overworld and use them in your world.

faqEntries.heading: How do I return to the Overworld?
faqEntries.content:
Craft a Dinosaur Portal in a Crafting Table using 8 Fossil Bricks, then place it inside the Dinosaur Dimension. Interact with each of the 4 portal corners using 1 Amber Gem per corner to power the portal. Once all 4 corners are powered, step inside the portal to return to the Overworld.

Note: Fossil Bricks and Amber Ore can be found underground and inside structures throughout the Dinosaur Dimension.

howToEntries.heading: Enter the Dinosaur Dimension
howToEntries.content:
1) Find the Materials
Fossil Bricks and Amber Ore naturally generate underground in the Overworld. Collect:
* 8 Fossil Bricks
* 4 Amber Gems

Fossil Bricks are about as rare as Coal Ore.
Amber Ore is about as rare as Gold Ore.

2) Craft the Portal
Use 8 Fossil Bricks in a Crafting Table to craft the Dinosaur Portal.

3) Place the Portal
Place the Dinosaur Portal on the ground.

4) Power the Portal
Use 4 Amber Gems. Interact with an Amber Gem on each of the 4 portal corners to power the portal.

5) Enter the Dimension
Step inside the powered portal to travel to the Dinosaur Dimension.

If you run into any problems, join our Discord and our team will help you out!

howToEntries.heading: Craft Gear & Special Weapons
howToEntries.content: Use Dinosaur Bones, Dinosaur Scales, Amber Gems, and other prehistoric materials to craft new armor, tools, and weapons. Defeat powerful dinosaurs and bosses to collect rare materials for special weapons with unique abilities.

howToEntries.heading: Tame, Ride & Breed Dinosaurs
howToEntries.content:
Feed a tameable dinosaur its favorite food to tame it. Carnivores like Dinosaur Meat, herbivores like Prehistoric Berries or Prehistoric Grapes, and the T-Rex lkesDinosaur Drumsticks.

Once tamed, equip the dinosaur with a Saddle and interact to ride it. 

Feed two breedable adults of the same species their favorite food to produce an egg, then interact with the egg to hatch the baby.

howToEntries.heading: Morph Into Dinosaurs
howToEntries.content:
You can morph into Triceratops, Ankylosaurus, Parasaurolophus, Pteranodon, and Tyrannosaurus Rex.

Defeat a morphable dinosaur and collect its head. Combine the head with 1 Amber Gem in a Crafting Table to craft its Totem of Morphing. Hold the totem and interact to transform into the dinosaur.  

Each morph has its own unique abilities that can be activated from the hotbar. Use Cancel Morph in your hotbar to return to your normal form.

howToEntries.heading: Use Dinosaur Abilities
howToEntries.content: Rideable dinosaurs and dinosaur morphs have unique abilities for movement, combat, and exploration. Ride a Pteranodon to fly, charge through trees with a Triceratops, or dig with an Ankylosaurus. Dinosaur morphs unlock additional abilities such as Sky Dash, Armored Roll, Battle Roar, and more.

howToEntries.heading: How to use the Chisel
howToEntries.content:
The Chisel is a special tool used to reshape wooden blocks into new custom blocks.

A Chisel can be crafted from different materials, just like vanilla tools. The Chisel material affects its chiseling speed and durability.

How to Use:
Interact with a compatible wooden block using a Chisel to turn it into a chiseled block.

Examples:
Wooden stairs → Chiseled Roof Block
Wooden planks → Chiseled Wooden Pillar
Wooden slabs → Chiseled Thin Wooden Slab

Note:
Interact with a chiseled block using a Chisel to return it to its original block.

Matching chiseled blocks connect when placed next to each other horizontally or vertically.
